label: Surface of revolution formula
section: From the sum to the integral
subgoals: Replace each curve chord by a cone frustum
Apply the mean value theorem to the chord length
Take the limit to S = 2pi times the integral of f times sqrt(1+(f')^2)

visual.title: Slant length, not thickness
visual.caption: A slice of the surface is a band, and its width is the slant length of the profile rather than dx. That extra factor is why surface area is not the derivative of volume.

predict.question: The surface area element of a body of revolution is:
predict.explain: The band width is the arc length ds = √(1 + f′²) dx. Replacing dx with ds is exactly what distinguishes surface area from volume.
